newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisnave tumbles on Lisbon bourse.
newsitem.headline: Lisnave tumbles on Lisbon bourse.

text.p: Shares of Portuguese ship repairer Lisnave fell by 30 percent on Lisbon bourse to 490 escudos after the Financial Markets Committee (CMVM) lifted a suspension of trade in the stock, dealers said.
Lisnave issued a statement in the local press today saying that its capital would drop to 3.6 billion escudos from the present 35.6 billion under a restructuring plan.
The CMVM suspended the stock on Wednesday after Lisbon bourse interrupted trade to seek more information about the company's restructuring.
Lisnave shares stood at 490 escudos, down 210, in volume of 206,100 at 0938 GMT.
